I saved Pree's note in gbrain as a fact about Marrow Agrisupply: the new inbound lane is at Dock 23. The record names Pree, #central-team and the message ts as the source. I also replied to Pree in the thread to say it's noted, and did nothing else since they said no action was needed.

The brain has no embedding provider set up, so it only catches exact duplicates. If someone saves this fact again in different words, it will be stored twice.
